brief.description: Faithful 32x-aligned material wear on damageable equipment icons
brief.purpose: Make below-100% grade legible while retaining the installed pack's silhouettes and keeping 100%+ pristine.
brief.silhouette: No replacement silhouette; transparent scuffs sit within the source alpha only.
brief.materials: Restrained rust, dark scratches, wood abrasion, leather wear and cooler diamond/turtle marks.
brief.states: One to eight non-animated layers as grade falls below 100%; no overlay at 100% or higher. A persistent per-item seed chooses the layers.
brief.construction: Deterministic Python generation of sixteen composable transparent 32x32 variants per item. Faithful alpha and brightness guide placement; source color pixels are never copied to the mod.
brief.invariants: No change to the base item sprites, equipment recipes or active-pack pixels. Every mark remains inside the Faithful 32x alpha silhouette.

concept.prompt_note: The exact image-generation prompt from the concept call was not retained in the asset folder. The production brief is recorded above; do not treat the concept as shipped pixels.
concept.review: The earlier five-chestplate concept established a clean-to-worn direction. Fixed per-type marks were later rejected: they were faint and made every same-grade item identical. The final exporter uses connected, seeded marks on the material's lit faces; the model wrapper preserves every selected overlay pass.

source_pack: Faithful 32x - 26.2.zip in the local Civilization Dev Prism instance; alpha/brightness placement reference only, never redistributed
outputs: Sixteen 32x32 transparent variant PNGs and model JSONs per item under assets/civilization/{textures,models}/item/grade_wear; 69 item identities, 1104 variants, approximately 294 KB of generated source resources
runtime: EquipmentGrade.java persists the per-item wear seed; client/GradeModels.java selects up to eight distinct variants after the resource-pack base model; client/GradeBar.java draws grade capacity over the native durability bar.
review: Faithful 32x native inventory screenshot in runs/visual/screenshots/inventory-grades.png (ignored test output); shader-disabled hidden client passed. Pixel-aligned comparison found 112 changed pixels between two 45% iron swords with different seeds, 79 between 45% and 100%, and zero between pristine 100% and 115% icons. Photon was not retested after its earlier shader-initialization stall. Worn armor on the player model and changed-silhouette packs remain outside this pass.
